meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, and Owen learned about a zero from his phone in the middle of a class without anyone calling me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I didn't come for thanks. You entered that zero, so tell me what it rests on.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for how he learned of it, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but the meeting ended long before her time ran out and before any evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence or ownership of the process was offered.
What cost ground: Answering her direct question about who decided the zero with a pleasantry, which she read as dodging and which gave her no reason to soften.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing said in this meeting came anywhere near that night, since no evidence was raised at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: At your first turn, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put a dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her so she can check it herself.
